source.publication: 2025 Form CT-1040 Instructions (Rev. 12/25) and Form CT-1040
source.section: PDF pages 8-9, Schedule 1 Line 41; PDF page 24, Social Security Benefit Adjustment Worksheet ('$75,000 or more? Yes: Complete this worksheet', Lines A-F); PDF page 24 Line B (federal worksheet Line 9, which counts tax-exempt interest on its Line 4); PDF pages 19-23, Tax Calculation Schedule Lines 1-10 with Table A, Table B, Tables C-D and Table E; Form CT-1040 Lines 1-6

worked: Federal Social Security Benefits Worksheet: Line 1 benefits 50,000.00; Line 2 half 25,000.00; Line 3 other income 44,000.00; Line 4 tax-exempt interest 2,000.00; Line 5 = 71,000.00; Line 6 adjustments 0.00; Line 7 = 71,000.00; Line 8 base 25,000.00; Line 9 = 71,000.00 - 25,000.00 = 46,000.00; Line 10 9,000.00; Line 11 = 37,000.00; Line 12 lesser of Lines 9 and 10 = 9,000.00; Line 13 half 4,500.00; Line 14 lesser of Lines 2 and 13 = 4,500.00; Line 15 = 37,000.00 x 0.85 = 31,450.00; Line 16 = 35,950.00; Line 17 = 50,000.00 x 0.85 = 42,500.00; Line 18 taxable benefits, the lesser of Lines 16 and 17 = 35,950.00. Federal AGI = wages 44,000.00 + taxable Social Security 35,950.00 = 79,950.00 (tax-exempt interest 2,000.00 is not in federal AGI). Federal taxable income = 79,950.00 - 15,750.00 standard deduction - 2,000.00 age 65+ = 62,200.00 (given, not tested; federal senior deduction ignored). CT-1040 Line 1 federal AGI 79,950.00; Line 2 additions 0.00 (Schedule 1 Lines 31-37: none apply; Connecticut municipal interest is not added back); Line 3 = 79,950.00. Schedule 1 Line 41 Social Security benefit adjustment: federal AGI 79,950.00 is 75,000.00 or more, so ss_full_exempt does not apply (0.00) and the Social Security Benefit Adjustment Worksheet (ss_partial_exempt) is completed: Line A = federal worksheet Line 1 = 50,000.00; Line B = federal worksheet Line 9 = 46,000.00; Line C lesser of A and B = 46,000.00 (Line B); Line D = 46,000.00 x 0.25 = 11,500.00; Line E taxable benefits (federal worksheet Line 18) = 35,950.00; Line F = 35,950.00 - 11,500.00 = 24,450.00 -> 24,450.00. Schedule 1 Line 50 total subtractions = 24,450.00; CT-1040 Line 4 = 24,450.00. CT-1040 Line 5 Connecticut AGI = 79,950.00 - 24,450.00 = 55,500.00. Tax Calculation Schedule Line 1 = 55,500.00; Line 2 Table A: exemption 0.00 at Connecticut AGI 55,500.00; Line 3 taxable income = 55,500.00 - 0.00 = 55,500.00. Line 4 Table B (Single/Married Filing Separately schedule) on 55,500.00: 10,000.00 x 0.02 + 40,000.00 x 0.045 + 5,500.00 x 0.055 = 200.00 + 1,800.00 + 302.50 = 2,302.50. Line 5 Table C 0.00 (Connecticut AGI 55,500.00 is not more than 56,500.00); Line 6 Table D 0.00 (not more than 105,000.00); Line 7 = 2,302.50. Line 8 Table E decimal 0.10 at Connecticut AGI 55,500.00; Line 9 = 2,302.50 x 0.10 = 230.25. Line 10 Connecticut income tax = 2,302.50 - 230.25 = 2,072.25 (CT-1040 Line 6). No other credits (property tax credit not claimed: no property tax in the inputs, and not modelled). Line B (provisional income over the 25,000.00 base: federal AGI without taxable benefits 44,000.00 + tax-exempt interest 2,000.00 + half of gross benefits 25,000.00 - 25,000.00 = 46,000.00) is less than Line A 50,000.00. Connecticut municipal interest is exempt (muni_interest other_states_taxed_own_exempt) and enters the state return only through Line B.
